technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish (50/200 EMA, supertrend) but short-term momentum weak (RSI neutral, MACD negative, price below key MAs); lacks confluence for high-probability swing entry.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minor confirmation but insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (433), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, and imminent NFP event creating near-term volatility; earnings in 84 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (50/200 EMA bullish, supertrend bullish) with price near support (130.0003) in extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), negative short-term momentum (MACD -0.9164, RSI neutral, price below 21-MA), zero confluence signals, and high earnings risk in 84 days make this a low-probability entry with unfavourable risk/reward.
